Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.

Will you be joining our team?

Job description 

For a large transport company, you will be working in their distribution center, moving trailers from the parking area to the loading docks and vice versa. You will do this using a Terberg (terminal tractor), a machine specifically designed for this task.

You will communicate via onboard radio with the planning team, who will assign your tasks. For smooth communication, a good knowledge of Dutch or English is required.

There are different shifts: from 04:00 to 14:00, from 05:00 to 17:00, or from 14:00 to 22:00.

A C/CE driving license is required, but Code 95 is not necessary.

 Requirements 

    
• C/CE driving license
    
• Good parking skills with tractor-trailer
    
• Sense of responsibility and focus on safety
    
• Ability to handle stress
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Job description 
 Our client specializes in solving logistical challenges that others cannot handle. Whether it’s a large machine part, a box of special screws, or medical equipment, their drivers ensure every delivery is handled carefully and delivered on time. 
For this position, we are looking for a driver with a strong sense of responsibility.
 What does the job involve? 
    
• Daily start times vary between 05:00 and 08:00, with your schedule sent by SMS the evening before
    
• Finishing times are flexible, as new assignments can come in throughout the day
    
• You will drive across the Benelux and occasionally beyond, delivering to hospitals, factories, and companies in cities such as Rotterdam, Amsterdam, and Brussels
    
• You transport one load per trip (dedicated transport): directly from point A to point B
    
• After a delivery in places like Düsseldorf, you may continue through Amsterdam and Antwerp before returning home
    
• Some days involve only national trips, usually shorter routes but following the same dedicated transport principle
    
• You will cover many kilometers while generally being home every weekend
    
• Most assignments are day trips, although overnight stays in the truck are possible by agreement
 Flexibility & work-life balance 
The dispatcher takes your private schedule into account whenever possible with timely communication, but flexibility remains essential for this role.
 Depot location 
Your truck starts and ends each day at the depot in Duffel, so having your own transport to reach the location is required.

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license + Code 95
    
• Strong sense of responsibility
    
• Independent working attitude
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English

Job description 

At this correct company with a family atmosphere, you will drive with clean and well-maintained equipment and primarily do large distribution of pallet goods in the Benelux, France, and Germany.

You will leave early and drive for quite a few hours, but you will still sleep in your own bed every night. You will receive your schedule via the onboard computer (Transics), so you can usually depart from home.

All hours are paid, and in case of any issues, you can always rely on the planning team that will support you. So, if you are a motivated driver with some experience who wants to earn a good income while being home every day, please contact us, and we will ensure you can start quickly!

 Requirements 

    
• License C/CE with the necessary certificates
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Physically fit, you load & unload yourself
    
• Experience as a driver and within the sector
    
• Independent, safety, and collegial are some of your keywords
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch/English

Job description 

Earn like an international driver while being home every day!

    
• Collection of waste and press containers with recycled paper
    
• Daily trips within Belgium to companies
    
• Flexible start times between 03:00 and 06:00
    
• Average of 12 working hours per day, with the possibility to work more if desired
    
• 2 to 5 trips per day
    
• Experience with hook lift systems and truck-trailer combinations is a plus, but can be learned on the job
    
• Work from Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays in consultation
    
• Hours above 38/week and Saturday hours paid at 150%
    
• Preferably living in the Antwerp, Turnhout, or Hoogstraten region
    
• Permanent contract after a successful interim period
    
• More working hours = higher salary

Interested? Apply now!

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license
    
• Valid Code 95
    
• Experience is required
    
• Flexible attitude
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English
    
• Departure from Merksem

Job description 

Are you someone who enjoys getting on the road and loves long drives? Do you have a CE driving license and are you looking for a job where you can rack up the miles? Then definitely read on!

What will you do?

You will deliver new, empty oil drums with a mega trailer. You leave every day from Lier and primarily drive in Belgium and the Netherlands. You start between 4 AM and 7 AM and make between 3 to 8 stops a day. Sometimes you unload the drums yourself (for a nice extra fee). Occasionally, there is work on Saturdays, but that's at 150% pay.

What do we expect?

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English. You possess a CE driving license with the necessary documents. You have some experience driving a mega trailer. Physical work is not a problem for you, and you do it with a smile.You may be required to operate different types of trailers and transport various kinds of goods. Therefore, it is important that you are flexible and open to a variety of tasks.

What do you get?

A well-filled odometer - lots of miles to cover. A stable job at a company that values you. Attractive and fair compensation, including extras for physical tasks and weekend work. Job security and a fixed departure and arrival location in Lier.

Are you eager to hit the road? Let us know and respond today!

 Requirements 

    
• You possess a CE driving license and all necessary documents (Code 95, driver card).
    
• You have experience driving a mega trailer.
    
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
    
• You enjoy working with different types of trailers and various goods. No day is the same!
    
• Physically demanding work does not deter you, and you carry out your tasks with a smile.
    
• You have your own transportation to get to the site.

jobs.description:
Be part of our team!

 

AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. AT&S industrializes leading-edge technologies for its core business segments Mobile Devices & Substrates, Automotive & Aerospace, Industrial and Medical and high-performance computing for AI applications. We are looking for talent eager to shape the future of our interconnected world. With plants in Austria, China, India, Malaysia and sales offices around the globe, we offer excellent career opportunities for creators, innovators and enablers with the drive to make a difference.

 

To enhance our successful R&D Glass Core PKG Team in Leoben, Austria, we are looking for a passionate 1 Engineer R&D - Glass Core PKG - Product and Process Reliability In your role, you will drive the development and reliability enhancement of next-generation glass core substrate technologies. Working closely with material suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams, you will contribute to the design, evaluation, and qualification of innovative packaging solutions for advanced semiconductor applications. Your expertise will help ensure robust product performance, manufacturing excellence, and technology readiness for future market demands. 

Your Responsibilities 

 * Develop mechanical defect-free process for glass core substrate by working closely with materials suppliers

 * Lead the reliability design, evaluation, and qualification of glass core substrate, including TGV structure and coating configuration

 * Conduct reliability test plans covering thermal cycling, mechanical stress, warpage behavior, and electrical stability

 * Analyze failure mechanisms such as TGV cracking, SeWaRe, and CTE-mismatch effects

 * Manage cross-functional tasks and technical documentation

 * Analyze experimental data and provide input and recommendations to enhance product performance and improve process efficiency 

Your Profile 

 * Bachelor's/Master's in materials science, mechanical engineering, electronics packaging, or related fields

 * 3+ years of experience in reliability engineering, materials reliability, or packaging/ substrate technology development

 * Expertise in thermo-mechanical reliability, and failure mode analysis

 * Familiarity with JEDEC/IPC standards and familiarity with stress simulation (preferred)

 * Strong responsibility-driven mindset for goal achievement reliably and quickly

 * Strong technical aptitude with willingness to develop problem-solving skills further

 * Effective collaboration and communication skills

 * Fluency in English 

Our Offer 

 * A meaningful role with opportunities for long-term growth in an international environment 

 * Chance to actively contribute to AT&S' success and to create value 

 * A structured and tailor-made onboarding program along with continual training opportunities

 * Modern company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day

 * Free parking spaces and e-charging stations

 * Diverse health measures and a wide range of employee benefits

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simp... 3 Operations Associate, Courier Community (m/w/d) Vienna 1030, fulltime

The Operations Associate, Courier Community acts as the heartbeat of the courier partner support ecosystem. Serving as the first line of human support beyond frontline Customer Support, this role is the critical bridge between Wolt and its courier partners. 

In this role, you will balance deep empathy with efficient, high-volume problem-solving - handling complex escalations, localized communications, sensitive account situations, and workflow automations that keep courier partners informed, supported, and valued.

Key Responsibilities
Inbox Management & Advanced Support

 * Manage courier inbox channels to handle complex, partner-submitted requests.
 * Resolve escalated tickets transferred from Support that fall outside frontline scope, including complaints, bug reports, and sensitive account updates.
 * Maintain team SLAs by keeping inbox tasks within a target 72-hour reply rate and resolving open board tickets efficiently.

Content Ownership & Localization

 * Localize regional and global courier-facing communications for specific country languages and cultural contexts.
 * Maintain and continuously update localized courier platforms, including country FAQs, educational content, and operational resources.
 * Proactively maintain information accessibility so couriers can easily self-solve issues without contacting support.

Cross-Functional Communication & Enablement

 * Coordinate ad-hoc courier announcements (e.g., weather-related boosts) in alignment with Communications and Supply Activation teams.
 * Create macros, guidance documents, and tools for Customer Support to empower frontline agents to resolve cases independently.
 * Assist onboarding teams with document verification, profile activations, and country-specific onboarding tasks.

Community Engagement & Feedback Loops

 * Drive community engagement by supporting local feedback initiatives and courier events.
 * Capture operational insights from courier feedback and translate them into process, documentation, and tool improvements.

AI & Process Automation

 * Leverage AI tools day-to-day to generate clear, empathetic response templates and reduce manual workloads for routine inquiries.
 * Utilize AI and self-service tools to summarize ticket escalations, maintain up-to-date knowledge bases, and build smart routing workflows.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Impact

 * Courier Satisfaction: Measured through feedback scores, response quality, and communication empathy.
 * Time to Resolution (TTR): Fast, efficient, and accurate resolution for complex tickets passed from Support or directly from courier partners.
 * Inflow Reduction: Lower overall ticket volume achieved through scalable documentation, improved Support macros, and self-service automation.
 * Localization Quality: High accuracy and quick turnaround time for market-specific announcements and content updates.

Our humble expectations
 * Professional working experience in Customer Support, Operations or other similar roles.
 * Professional level in English and (Austrian) German.
 * Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets.
 * Strong capability to diagnose operational issues, identify root causes, and determine when and how to escalate.
